† [עָרַג] vb. long for (cf. Arabic عَرَجَ ascend, ii. bend, incline toward (على); عَرِيجٌ high, elevated; Ethiopic ዐርገ ascend; NH עֲרוּגָה = BH);—
Qal Impf. 3 fs. תַּעֲרֹג ψ 42:2 (of stag, c. עַל rei in sim.); c. אֶל, of longing for God v 2 (subj. נַפְשִׁי), so תַּעֲרוֹג Jo 1:20 (of beasts, craving water).
